llm.summary: This is a low-risk Chinese-language storytelling aid made of Markdown templates and examples, with no code execution or sensitive access.

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request local file access, credentials, network use, shell commands, or mutation authority beyond using bundled reference files as writing templates.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains Markdown files only, no executable scripts, dependencies, installer hooks, or remote payload retrieval.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are scoped to storytelling workflows and explicitly say the full skill is usually unnecessary for small dialogue edits; the main limitation is that the materials and triggers are Chinese-language only.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, memory writes, privilege escalation, or tool modification behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently support the stated purpose of developing long-form series outlines, episode structures, character arcs, and season hooks.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this if you want Chinese-language help planning long-form fiction or screen series. Users who need another language should confirm the agent can translate or adapt the templates, but there is no artifact-backed indication of code execution, data access, or persistence.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The repeated language findings are supported by the artifact: the skill, templates, and examples are in Chinese. This is a usability/localization limitation rather than evidence of hidden behavior, sensitive authority, or security risk.
